name: session-board
description: A live board for Claude Code: model, context, limits and cost, AI-SDLC progress read from your repo, subagent cards and every permission check. Read-only; unreadable values show N/A.

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Comma-separated panels in display order: main, sdlc, agents, gate. Leave one out to hide it.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto: a summary above the prompt when the pane sits inline, two columns from 110 columns when docked, one column otherwise

maxCards.title: Cards before swimlanes
maxCards.description: Agent cards drawn side by side; more agents than this switch to swimlanes (1-6)

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Animate the connectors while real work flows, or keep them still

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: theme follows your Claude Code theme; pastel is fixed colours tuned for dark terminals

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the board when a session starts
